title: SnapFlow: One-Step Action Generation for Flow-Matching VLAs via Progressive Self-Distillation
authors: Wuyang Luan, Junhui Li, Weiguang Zhao, Rui Ma, Tieru Wu

tldr.en: Self-distill a pretrained flow policy with local velocity and stop-gradient shortcut targets; add destination-time conditioning for one-NFE generation.
tldr.zh: 联合局部速度监督与停止梯度的捷径目标自蒸馏预训练策略，增加目标时间条件，实现一次网络求值生成。

evaluation_scope.en: π0.5/π0, LIBERO and humanoid retrieval; archived π0.5 batch-one model timing uses A800-80G. Model-path timing is not sensor-to-actuation latency.
evaluation_scope.zh: π0.5/π0、LIBERO 与人形机器人取物；归档 π0.5 的 batch=1 模型计时使用 A800-80G。模型路径耗时不等于传感到执行延迟。
